svg.title: Eight-Pillar Proof Architecture
svg.desc: Vertical four-stage architectural flow diagram of the condensed 8-pillar Lean 4 formalization of the Riemann Hypothesis and Generalized Riemann Hypothesis in leanprover-community/riemann-hypothesis at upstream commit 41c2716658c4. Stage 1 (Branch A, Upper Bound, Theorem A: Shortness) flows from 02_derivatives (23 files: theta jets, formal groups and p-adic prime divisibility; Count, ThetaProducts, BoundAttained) to 03_upper_bound (THEOREM A, 55 files: composite theta lift, seesaw_identity, Archimedean size and divisibility; ShortColumns, ElementaryDivisorTheorem). Stage 2 (Branch B, Spanning, Theorem B: Enough Translates) is the full-width card 04_spanning (THEOREM B, 90 files: second moment of normalized Poincare series, Bessel unfolding and sieve; SpanningTheorem, Moments, EnergyEstimate). Stage 3 (Branch C, Lower Bound Chain, Theorem C: Longness) flows from 07_congruences (53 files: Galois reps, Ribet's method, Selmer and crystalline lifting; FitTwistsExist, DenominatorBound) to 06_one_lift (24 files: single-lift height Z_j(1)/Z_j(xi^j), gluing and false lifts; LiftVolumeHeight, GluingMaps, ThreeExchanges) and down into 05_determinant (THEOREM C, 33 files: regular twists, Siegel-Weil exchange/square identities and chain determinant; LongForms, NormOfChain, OneSquare). Stage 4 shows Theorem A, Theorem B, and Theorem C converging into 01_reduction (CONVERGENCE, 18 files: TwistedLattice Bost slope plus star_inequality where mainAmount cancels, yielding OneSidedBound R_q0(x) <= C x^(-1/2+epsilon), Landau/Suzuki Criterion, New.grh, and New.Main), which feeds via import New.Main into 00_statement (OUTPUT CONTRACT, 3 files plus comparator.json: src/Main.lean proves 5 RH/GRH theorems against Challenge.lean and comparator.json with enable_nanoda: true, explicitly flagged with an amber dashed status bar unverified-locally, STATIC ONLY, no lake build). Scope footer: 41 landmarks (0 isolated), 305 src/New/ files (296 in 7 pillars plus 9 Appendix), 495 src/Lib/ files, upstream 41c2716658c4.
